data.exact_reserve_text: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made. The methods used, and the estimates made, are reviewed regularly.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Acceptance of RITC into Syndicate 3268 increased gross claims outstanding as shown in technical provisions; RITC gross addition of GBP 20,660k recorded in 2020 technical provisions.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased from GBP 71.07m at 1 January 2020 to GBP 114.56m at 31 December 2020. A material component of the increase was the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) accepted from Syndicate 6126 (gross GBP 20.66m). The technical provisions note also records an overall change in claims outstanding and currency movements; the report does not present a single, explicit gross figure solely quantifying prior-year reserve movement (prior-year only re-estimation), and the presence of RITC distorts straightforward interpretation of development by underwriting year.
raw_causal_phrases: Effect of movements in exchange rates
This includes consideration of the potential impact of COVID assumptions.
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
data.data_quality_notes: No single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was presented. The technical provisions show total gross change and a material RITC addition (gross GBP 20.66k) which distorts claims development analysis; therefore prior-year-only development could not be isolated from the published tables. Premium mix was taken from the Managing Agent summary (divisional summary) as no separate statutory segmental note was available in the extracted text. Claims development triangle in the report is present but extraction is partially garbled and is affected by RITC; triangle-based PYD would be unreliable.
